The four colored source-label symbols in `romfs/images/emoji-*.png` are from
[Google Noto Emoji](https://github.com/googlefonts/noto-emoji), revision
`191f7be36407b2bc683f4fbfa17c2dfd60ad10f2` (`png/128`). They depict
U+1F493, U+1F4A5, U+1F387, and U+1F349. The image resources are distributed
under the Apache License 2.0 in [NotoEmoji-LICENSE.txt](NotoEmoji-LICENSE.txt).
